description: Split a PDF: keep pages (mode=pick, pages='1-3, 5'), remove pages (mode=remove) or one PDF per page (mode=each). Password-protected PDFs open with password. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pdf-split.

fileContent.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI is fine)

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf

password.description: PDF password if it is protected

name: pdf_split
title: PDF Split API - extract or remove pages, one file per page
